evidence.quote: The Riverbend pilot ran for 18 months, from March 2023 to August 2024.

claims.text: Contamination fell to 4 percent by the final quarter.

evidence.quote: Contamination in the final quarter fell to 4 percent, down from 11 percent at launch.

claims.text: Households paid a flat fee of 12 dollars per month.
The program diverted 310 tons from landfill.

evidence.quote: Total diversion reached 310 tons over the pilot period.
